item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for MySQL on Premium SSD v2
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports Premium SSD v2 managed disks in public preview. The update adds higher performance and better price-performance, with the ability to scale storage capacity independently.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Rename Server in Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports generally available server renaming. Existing server instances can be renamed without recreating the server, migrating data, or disrupting applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Reader Endpoint for Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server now has a public preview of a reader endpoint to simplify connection management when using multiple replicas. The endpoint provides automatic load balancing for read-only connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates
